source: room-profile.md / room-profile.json — mined from the 2024-2025 league drafts

semantics.keying: teams are keyed by ESPN teamId (stable across seasons). Draft slots are assigned by ESPN ~1h before the draft; slot labels are display-time data derived from the live pickOrder, never stored here.
semantics.sigma: team's measured early-round pick σ (board rank ≤ 100); null = base model (sigmaForPick). The model scales the base σ curve by sigma/8, the league's measured flat early σ.
semantics.sigmaScale: confidence multiplier on the team's σ curve (default 1.0). > 1 = flatter, less predictable — used where standings suggest an elevated chance of deliberate behavior change, never to invent taste. `sigmaScaleEvidence` carries the finishes behind it.
semantics.pos-boost: multiply the position's take weight by `strength` (> 1) in rounds [from, to] inclusive
semantics.pos-suppress: multiply the position's take weight by `strength` (< 1) in rounds [from, to] inclusive
semantics.loyalty: multiply the named player's take weight by `strength` at this team's picks, every round
semantics.precedence: a team rule for a position replaces any default rule for that position in the rounds it covers; defaults apply to every team otherwise
semantics.evidence: keys are rule indexes into `rules`; values are the historical picks behind the rule, for tooltips

notes: Standings context: the room watched ESPN's default board win the 2025 title (Lehmer's full-autodraft season) — further support for ESPN-faithful room behavior.
Standings feed confidence (sigmaScale) only; taste rules come from observed picks. Finishes are luck-heavy: 7-7 won 2024.
